candidates.title: Name the noise the kernel writes: the mediator behind idea 004's reconstruction shifts
candidates.question: When CT-CLIP's abnormality scores shift between two reconstructions of the same acquisition, is the model using the high-spatial-frequency noise texture that the sharper kernel writes into the image?
candidates.deliverable_sentence: When its scores move between reconstructions of the same scan, the model is using the sharper kernel's high-spatial-frequency noise texture.
candidates.successor_basis: The 2026-08-16 ratification of idea 004 states: 'identifying the mediating spatial-frequency or noise-texture quantity requires a successor idea through the normal pipeline.' This card is that successor, entering as a new candidate per the claim-identity governance rule. Not a revival: idea 004 is complete, not blocked.
candidates.rung: Targets rung 1-2 for a physical X: the charter admits physical things, and 'identification of a decisive confound' is a listed success. X here IS the artifact, positively named - the inverse of the standard rung-2 failure, where an anatomical X is claimed and the artifact never excluded. Moving up means showing the same mediation on a second vendor's kernel pairs.
candidates.rung_reached: Rung 1 (the model uses measured noise-texture change) plus a scoped rung-2-style statement (the mediator is acquisition physics, not anatomy) if the synthesis arm reproduces the natural per-head shift pattern. Vendor scope stays Siemens-only, inherited from Stage 0.
candidates.unfinished_story: Idea 004 is this program's one completed study: 425 geometry-matched kernel pairs, 18 heads, per-head paired score-delta distributions ratified. It established THAT reconstruction-dependent content moves the scores and explicitly stopped short of naming WHAT. The per-pair difference volume of each ratified pair contains exactly and only the changed content, and nobody has measured it.
candidates.X_measurement: Two formulaic quantities per pair, no annotator: (1) noise magnitude change - standard deviation of HU in automatically segmented homogeneous regions (tracheal air, paraspinal muscle, subcutaneous fat), sharper minus softer; (2) band-resolved energy of the voxelwise difference volume B minus A, computed by 3D Fourier decomposition into low/mid/high spatial-frequency bands - since anatomy is identical within a ratified pair, the difference volume isolates precisely the reconstruction-dependent content. Noise-power-spectrum methodology is standard (ICRU Report 87; Samei et al. performance-evaluation literature); kernel-to-kernel conversion by Fourier-domain filtering is published (Ohkubo et al., Med Phys 2011 - identifier to be pinned in the novelty audit; recalled, unverified). Compute-today test: YES - volumes are public on HuggingFace and the exact pair list with volume filenames is frozen in-repo.
candidates.suspected_signal: Sharp kernels boost high-spatial-frequency content, raising noise power concentrated at frequencies overlapping fine parenchymal structure (septal lines, small vessels, reticulation). A classifier trained on mixed-kernel data can learn heads whose evidence lives partly in that band; pleural effusion's ratified directional median is a concrete target. The mediator is physical and per-head: heads keyed to fine texture should track high-band energy change; heads keyed to large low-contrast structures should not.
candidates.use_vs_association: Association arm: regress each head's per-pair d_logit on measured per-pair noise/band-energy deltas across 424 counted pairs. Use arm: synthesize B-prime from the softer volume alone by matched spectral filtering plus noise injection - graded, so dose-response - and ask whether the synthetic shift reproduces the natural per-head shift pattern; separate noise-only injection from sharpening-only filtering to split noise texture from resolution. A label or population correlate cannot produce a graded within-scan response to a parameterized physical operator.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: The ratified per-pair, per-head paired scores are recoverable with volume identifiers so noise metrics computed on the public volumes can be joined to score deltas pair-by-pair.
candidates.keystone_evidence: probes/004/results_v2/analysis/tier1_differences.csv inspected 2026-08-18: 7,650 data rows = 425 pairs x 18 heads, columns pair_id, patient_id, stratum, anchor_excluded, exploratory, head_index, head_name, softer_prob, sharper_prob, d_prob, d_logit, n_clipped_members (first row: p001, valid_1004, Br40f|Br60f, ..., Medical material, 0.5627798438072205, 0.5593186616897583, ...). Volume filenames per pair are in probes/004/results_v2/chunks/*/per_sample.csv (e.g. valid_1004_a_1.nii.gz).
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: Having verified the deltas and identifiers exist, I am still assuming: (a) re-downloaded HuggingFace volumes are bit-identical to those scored - supported by the probe's frozen revision and anchor determinism but not re-verified for all 850; (b) within-stratum variation in noise-delta across pairs (driven by patient size and dose) is wide enough to support regression, since kernel labels are nearly constant within the 237-pair main stratum - this is load-bearing for the association arm and is the first Stage-0 measurement; the synthesis arm does not depend on it. (c) New inference (synthesis arm) requires a fresh contract and approval; nothing is authorized by idea 004's ADVANCE.
candidates.dies_like_prior: No prior kill-code applies cleanly: no labels enter the primary readout (annotation provenance moot), data and checkpoint are verified obtainable (not DATA_ACCESS), and the estimand is within-scan (not the cohort-confounding IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILURE of ideas 009/016/020). The live risk is a new one: noise magnitude and resolution change co-vary within a kernel pair, so the design must and does split them with separate injection arms; if the split fails, the honest landing is 'reconstruction-dependent content, band unresolved' - a narrower true claim, not a dead study.
candidates.closest_prior_work: Idea 004 itself (this repo; ratified 2026-08-16) established the phenomenon without the mediator. Kernel-harmonization literature (e.g., Fourier-filter kernel conversion, Ohkubo et al.; CNN kernel harmonization, Choe et al., Radiology 2019 - both recalled, unverified) shows kernels alter radiomics/texture measures but does not decode which band mediates a specific classifier's score shifts. Delta: per-head mediation analysis against a frozen ratified behavior, with a causal synthesis arm.
candidates.existing_assets: All 7,650 paired deltas in-repo; frozen pair manifest with SHA-256; verified deterministic local inference stack (bit-identical anchor across 5 sessions); public CT-RATE volumes; noise metrics are CPU-only; only the synthesis arm needs GPU sessions.
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: Stage 0 (CPU, no new inference): download 40 counted Br40f|Br60f pairs, compute noise-delta and band-energy metrics, verify measurable spread and join integrity, and report the cross-pair correlation between high-band energy delta and per-head |d_logit| for all 18 heads. Decisive step (fresh contract): on 30 softer volumes, apply graded noise-injection-only and sharpening-only operators matched to the measured pair spectra, and compare synthetic per-head shift patterns to each pair's natural shift.
candidates.standing_confounds_addressed: Scanner, vendor, protocol, site, positioning, habitus, prevalence, referral, and labels are all fixed within pair by construction - the idea-004 inheritance. Vendor scope (462/464 Siemens) is a stated limitation, not a confound. The remaining internal degeneracy is noise texture versus resolution/edge content, addressed by the split-operator arms; label leakage cannot operate because labels are unused.
alternative_explanations: Resolution (MTF) change of real anatomy, not noise, mediates the shift; the sharpening-only arm without noise injection tests this directly.
Preprocessing (resample to fixed grid, HU clip, /1000) nonlinearly transforms both; compute all metrics on the exact post-preprocessing tensor as well as native voxels.

Low-contrast large-structure differences (kernel-dependent smoothing of effusion margins) rather than parenchymal texture; band-resolved regression and head-pattern comparison address but may not fully exclude this.
candidates.anticipated_negative: Decisive: if matched-spectrum synthesis moves no head while natural pairs do, noise texture is rejected as the mediator for this checkpoint, and the ratified sensitivity must live in content the operators did not reproduce - a real narrowing either way.
candidates.remaining_legwork: Stage 0 metrics in 2-3 days on CPU; synthesis-arm contract drafting plus one GPU session; first decision inside two weeks.
candidates.entry_point_2_requirements: Measurement: band-resolved energy of the within-pair difference volume and homogeneous-ROI noise SD. Confusable artifact: resolution change of true anatomy, split off by the sharpening-only control arm.

data.primary: CT-RATE validation split, frozen idea-004 pair manifest
data.model: released v2 ClassFine checkpoint (frozen SHA-256 in-repo)

clarity.why: One physical quantity, one frozen behavior to explain, one parameterized operator.

identifiability.why: Within-pair design kills every population confound; the noise-versus-resolution degeneracy is addressed by split arms but preprocessing interactions may blur the split.

medical_relevance.why: Names the mediator of a demonstrated deployment-relevant fragility; no direct patient-level claim.

interest.why: It finishes the program's only completed story and converts 'reconstruction-dependent content' into a named physical quantity.

prior_legwork.why: All paired deltas, manifests, hashes, and a determinism-verified pipeline are already in-repo.

feasibility.why: Cap lifted by INSPECTED_TRUE; Stage 0 is CPU-only; the synthesis arm needs one contracted GPU session and operator validation.

data_readiness.why: Everything is public or in-repo; volumes must be re-downloaded.

evaluation_readiness.why: Regression and pattern-match endpoints are prespecifiable from existing per-head distributions.

negative_result_value.why: A synthesis null with a working operator decisively rejects the named mediator for this checkpoint.

novelty_confidence.why: Cap lifted but the kernel-harmonization interpretability literature is unaudited; held at 3 honestly.

regret.why: The difference volumes of 425 ratified pairs are sitting unmeasured; not doing this wastes the program's own best asset.

unverified_claims: Ohkubo and Choe citations recalled from memory, identifiers unpinned
Bit-identity of re-downloaded volumes beyond the probed anchor
Within-stratum spread of noise-delta
Novelty of per-head mediation analysis
candidates.plain_pitch: Hospitals often save the same CT scan twice, processed with a softer or sharper setting, and our earlier completed study proved that an AI disease-scorer gives measurably different answers on the two versions of the exact same body. This card asks the natural next question: is the difference caused by the grainy 'noise' the sharper setting adds to the picture? Because we already have all the paired scores on file, we can measure the graininess in each pair and then recreate it artificially, turning the dial up and down to see whether the scores follow. If they do, we will have named the precise physical ingredient that makes this AI unstable - something hospitals would need to control before trusting it.

candidates.title: The mortality model is wearing the patient's hardware
candidates.question: Is a chest-radiograph mortality model using implanted cardiac devices - pacemakers, defibrillators, sternotomy wires - as a visible record of treated disease?
candidates.deliverable_sentence: The mortality model is using implanted cardiac devices.
candidates.rung: Targets rung 1 by paired device removal; rung 2 asks whether the response reflects the device or its correlated silhouette/positioning context, addressed by the sham-inpainting control; rung 3 is nearly free because X is already a named clinical object - the open question would become how much risk the model assigns to hardware per se.
candidates.rung_reached: Rung 1 if score drops on validated device inpainting beyond shams; the treated-disease interpretation (rung 3 texture) needs the device-subtype dose pattern (defibrillator > pacemaker > wires) to behave sensibly.
candidates.unasked_question: CXR mortality models are documented to predict long-term death better than clinical risk scores and beyond what radiologists attempt (entry point 1: CXR-Risk, Lu et al., JAMA Netw Open 2019, DOI 10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2019.7416; CXR-Age, Raghu et al. 2021 - identifiers to be pinned). The interpretability discussion around them names lungs, heart size, and aortic calcification; nobody appears to have quantified how much of the signal is man-made objects in the field of view, though hardware is the single most unambiguous marker of established cardiac disease a radiograph contains.
candidates.X_measurement: Device presence, class, and projected area from an automated detector: published neural-network cardiac-device identification exists (Howard et al., cardiac rhythm device identification from CXR, ~2019 - identifier and code availability to be pinned; recalled, unverified), and PadChest-style device fields exist only as fallback validation, not as the measurement. If no released detector survives inspection, a fallback well-defined rule (very-high-opacity connected components over the cardiac/subclavian region with man-made geometry criteria) is stated but weaker on uncalibrated radiographs. Compute-today test: YES conditional on a released detector - this is checkable in one day and is an explicit Stage-0 gate.
candidates.suspected_signal: A pacemaker or defibrillator is implanted because conduction disease or heart failure already exists; sternotomy wires mean prior cardiac surgery. Hardware is therefore a high-contrast, spatially compact proxy for diagnosed severe disease and for treatment intensity - exactly the kind of shortcut a mortality model would learn, and one with real deployment consequences in either direction (double-counting treated disease, or crediting treatment).
candidates.use_vs_association: Association (device carriers die more) is clinically guaranteed and uninformative; the design requires a within-image paired readout - inpaint the device, hold everything else fixed, and measure the score change against sham inpainting of matched device-free regions - which no cohort correlation can mimic.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: A frozen, publicly obtainable chest-radiograph mortality (or biological-age) checkpoint that runs locally and produces a continuous score is available; without it there is no model behavior to decode.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The easy check is that the CXR-Risk/CXR-Age papers exist and describe released code; the load-bearing assumptions are that weights (not just architecture) are released under a usable license, and that device inpainting on radiographs stays in-distribution for that checkpoint - a smaller intervention than idea 006's patient deletion, but the same class of risk, so a discriminator/sham gate is mandatory, and its failure kills the causal arm.
candidates.dies_like_prior: Two prior modes threaten it: idea-018 (DATA_ACCESS - anchor model unobtainable) if weights are not truly released, and idea-006 (out-of-distribution intervention) if inpainting is detectable. Different from 018 because the papers advertise public code and the Stage-0 gate is a one-day check before any further investment; different from 006 because the edit is a small local texture replacement of a man-made object, with an explicit blinded-discriminator gate rather than an assumed-in-distribution deletion. Annotation provenance does not enter: the primary readout is paired model scores, and mortality labels are used nowhere.
candidates.closest_prior_work: CXR-Risk (DOI 10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2019.7416) and CXR-Age established the gap; saliency discussions in those papers gesture at anatomy, not devices. In-portfolio, scout-013-c03 (skeletal frailty in mortality prediction) and scout-010-c01 (CXR-Age decomposition into measurable parts) share the anchor family; neither names hardware, and neither uses a paired removal design. Device-detection networks (Howard et al.) supply the measurement but never connected it to prognosis models. Novelty unverified pending audit.
candidates.existing_assets: Public CXR cohorts with device-rich populations (MIMIC-CXR, PadChest, ChestX-ray8); published device-identification networks; mature radiograph inpainting methods; no labels needed for the primary endpoint.
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: Stage 0: verify checkpoint and detector availability (one day, kill-or-proceed). Then: on 100 device-positive radiographs, inpaint the device; on 100 matched device-negative radiographs, sham-inpaint the same anatomical region; require blinded-discriminator equivalence; compare paired score deltas, stratified by device class, with wires versus generators as an internal dose comparison.
candidates.standing_confounds_addressed: Within-image pairing fixes scanner, protocol, site, positioning, habitus, prevalence, and referral for the causal readout; label leakage is moot (labels unused). NOT ruled out: the inpainted region's underlying anatomy is counterfactual (we cannot know the true device-free chest), so the claim is 'removing the device's appearance changes the score,' not 'the device-free patient would score lower' - stated as a scope limit. Inpainting artifact is the dominant threat and is gated.
alternative_explanations: The model responds to any high-opacity foreign object, not cardiac devices specifically; test with non-cardiac hardware (spinal rods, port catheters) as a specificity arm.
The score change reflects inpainting texture artifacts; sham inpainting and discriminator equivalence address this.
Device carriers' images differ globally (rotation, effort, body habitus), which pairing removes for the causal arm but which contaminates any cohort-level effect-size extrapolation.
candidates.anticipated_negative: Decisive for the checkpoint tested: if a validated, invisible device removal never moves the score, the model is not using hardware, and the interpretability folklore about 'obvious' shortcuts loses a standard example. Sensitivity-limited only if the discriminator gate fails.
candidates.remaining_legwork: One day for the checkpoint/detector gate; about a week to validate inpainting; first paired readout within three weeks of a passed gate.

data.primary: MIMIC-CXR or PadChest device-positive subset (imaging only; labels unused)
data.model: released CXR-Risk or CXR-Age checkpoint (availability is the Stage-0 gate)

clarity.why: One object class, one removal operation, one paired endpoint; device-class taxonomy adds minor operational detail.

identifiability.why: Paired removal with sham and specificity arms isolates the object's appearance; the counterfactual-anatomy scope limit is stated rather than solved.

medical_relevance.why: Whether prognosis models double-count treated disease via hardware bears directly on fairness and deployment for every treated patient.

interest.why: A crisp, almost embarrassing question the interpretability literature has talked around; either answer is quotable.

prior_legwork.why: Anchor papers, device detectors, and inpainting methods all exist; none of the three has been locally verified.

data_readiness.why: Cohorts are public/credentialed-public; the model checkpoint is the open question.

evaluation_readiness.why: Paired deltas, sham controls, and device-class stratification are standard and prespecifiable.

negative_result_value.why: A gated null decisively removes hardware from the explanation space for this checkpoint.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped; the CXR-shortcut literature is large and needs a real audit for device-ablation precedents.

regret.why: If someone else publishes 'the mortality model was reading the pacemaker,' the miss will look obvious in hindsight.

unverified_claims: CXR-Risk/CXR-Age weight release and license
Howard et al. device-detector availability and exact identifier
Radiograph inpainting realism on device regions
Absence of prior device-ablation studies on prognosis models
candidates.plain_pitch: AI systems can look at an ordinary chest X-ray and predict how likely a person is to die in the next decade, better than standard risk calculators - and nobody fully knows what they are looking at. This card asks a blunt question: are they partly just noticing pacemakers, defibrillators, and surgical wires, which are unmistakable proof that serious heart disease was already diagnosed and treated? We test it by digitally removing the device from the image, changing nothing else, and watching whether the prediction drops. Either answer matters: if yes, these models partly re-read the medical chart off the patient's hardware, which changes how fairly they treat people who have already received care.

candidates.title: The fat inside the silhouette: epicardial adipose in the cardiomegaly score
candidates.question: Is CT-CLIP's cardiomegaly score using epicardial fat volume as part of what it counts as heart?
candidates.deliverable_sentence: The cardiomegaly score is using epicardial fat volume.
candidates.rung: Targets rung 1 via a fat-attenuation substitution probe on top of a conditional-observational base; rung 2 requires the substitution gates plus contrast-phase stratification; rung 3 is inherent - epicardial fat is a named, measured clinical quantity - with the interesting corollary that 'cardiomegaly' would partly mean adiposity.
candidates.rung_reached: Rung 1 if the score tracks fat volume at matched chamber volume AND responds to attenuation-only substitution; observational-only support lands at association, honestly below rung 1.
candidates.unasked_question: On radiographs, fat around the heart enlarges the silhouette and is a known reading pitfall with a name (epicardial fat pad). Whether a 3D CT model - which could in principle separate fat from myocardium by attenuation - nevertheless folds fat into its cardiomegaly call has, to current knowledge, never been asked of any released chest-CT classifier.
candidates.X_measurement: Epicardial adipose tissue volume: voxels in the -190 to -30 HU window within the pericardial sac, the standard published quantification (deep-learning EAT segmentation, Commandeur et al., ~2018, and threshold-within-pericardium methods - identifiers to be pinned); pericardial/cardiac masks from public segmentation tools, with the specific class availability to be inspected. Chamber/heart volume from the same segmentation for the matching variable. Compute-today test: YES conditional on a public pericardium-capable segmenter, an inspectable fact; EAT quantification on non-contrast CT is routine in the cardiac literature.
candidates.suspected_signal: Report-derived 'cardiomegaly' labels come from radiologists reading axial images where the fat-myocardium boundary is visible but the gestalt of 'big heart' includes the pericardial contour; a model trained on such labels can inherit a silhouette rule rather than a chamber rule. Epicardial fat volume also genuinely correlates with metabolic disease and atrial enlargement, giving the model a second, real reason to use it.
candidates.use_vs_association: Association arm: at matched heart-chamber volume, does EAT volume still predict the cardiomegaly score? Use arm: substitute fat-window voxels inside the pericardial sac toward myocardial attenuation (and the reverse) without moving any boundary, so silhouette and chamber geometry are bit-identical and only the tissue's identity changes - a correlated-label story cannot produce a response to a within-image attenuation swap.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: Cases dissociating fat from chamber volume exist with adequate support in CT-RATE (high-fat/normal-chambers and low-fat/large-chambers), and the cardiomegaly head has usable score variance across them; without joint support the conditional analysis collapses into the correlated cloud that killed idea 009's design.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The nearest checkable facts - CT-RATE is local-precedented, the checkpoint has a cardiomegaly head, EAT tools exist - are all adjacent. Still assumed and load-bearing: (a) dissociated-support density in this specific cohort; (b) the attenuation substitution stays in-distribution (same risk class as idea 006, gated by discriminator and sham swaps); (c) segmentation-quality on mixed contrast-phase chest CT is adequate for the matching variable.
candidates.dies_like_prior: Idea-010 (cardiomegaly, killed CIRCULARITY) is the name-twin but not the failure-twin: 010 asked whether the model re-derived heart size, an endpoint re-encoding the input; here X (fat) is definitionally NOT cardiomegaly, so a positive is a misattribution finding, not a restatement. The real inherited risks are idea-009's joint-support failure (met with an explicit Stage-0 support gate) and idea-006's out-of-distribution intervention (met with attenuation-only edits, shams, and a discriminator gate). Annotation provenance: report labels train the anchor model but appear nowhere in the primary paired readout.
candidates.closest_prior_work: In-portfolio: scout-014-c01 measures epicardial fat against a CVD-mortality model (Chao et al. lineage) - different model, different head, different question (prognostic signal there; category misattribution here); scout-014-c03 (Haller index in cardiomegaly) shares the head but tests skeletal geometry, not tissue identity. External: EAT quantification literature is mature; no study decoding fat's role inside a released chest-CT cardiomegaly classifier is known to me - unverified pending audit.
candidates.existing_assets: Frozen, determinism-verified CT-CLIP inference stack in-repo; CT-RATE validation metadata local; public segmentation tooling; standard EAT thresholds; both heads (cardiomegaly, pericardial effusion) available as a dissociation pair - fluid should move the effusion head, fat should not.
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: Stage 0: run segmentation on 150 validation volumes, quantify EAT and chamber volume, and report the joint-support density (kill if the dissociation quadrants are near-empty). Then: conditional regression of the cardiomegaly score on EAT at matched chamber volume; and on 30 dissociated cases, paired attenuation substitution fat-to-myocardium and myocardium-window shams, gated by blinded discriminator, reading both cardiac heads.
candidates.standing_confounds_addressed: The substitution arm fixes scanner, vendor, protocol, reconstruction, site, positioning, habitus, prevalence, referral, and labels within image. The observational arm controls chamber volume explicitly but leaves contrast phase, habitus, and metabolic comorbidity as correlates - stratify contrast phase; habitus remains partially confounded with EAT by biology and is stated, not solved. Label leakage cannot explain a within-image attenuation response.
alternative_explanations: The model reads total mediastinal soft-tissue bulk, not pericardial fat specifically; substitute mediastinal fat outside the sac as a specificity control.
Substitution artifacts drive the response; shams and discriminator gates address this.
EAT proxies body habitus, which the model reads elsewhere in the volume; the within-image swap isolates the pericardial contribution but the observational effect size stays habitus-contaminated.
candidates.anticipated_negative: Decisive for the use claim if joint support exists and the gated substitution moves nothing while chamber-volume edits (positive control from the literature-standard direction) or observed chamber variation clearly move the score; sensitivity-limited if support is thin.
candidates.remaining_legwork: Two days to verify segmentation classes; one week for Stage-0 support mapping; substitution probe within three weeks under a fresh contract.
candidates.entry_point_2_requirements: Measurement: EAT volume by the -190 to -30 HU pericardial window. Confusable artifact: contrast-phase-dependent tissue conspicuity and general body habitus; both named in the design.

clarity.why: Named tissue, standard measurement, two-arm design; 'what the head counts as heart' needs the substitution arm to be crisp.

identifiability.why: The attenuation-only swap at fixed geometry is a genuinely clean isolation, conditional on edit-validity gates; observational support is much weaker.

medical_relevance.why: If cardiomegaly scores partly measure adiposity, downstream uses of the label inherit a systematic bias with a named cause.

interest.why: A 3D model that could separate fat from muscle by physics, but may not, is a pointed finding either way.

prior_legwork.why: Inference stack frozen and verified; EAT methods standard; only the segmenter class check is new.

feasibility.why: Capped: joint support and segmenter classes uninspected.

data_readiness.why: Data and model are local-precedented and public.

evaluation_readiness.why: Conditional regression is standard; substitution-validity metrics are custom.

negative_result_value.why: Decisive only after the support gate and a working positive control.

novelty_confidence.why: Capped; the EAT and CXR-silhouette literatures are large and unaudited for this exact question.

regret.why: Worth doing given the frozen pipeline; not existential if skipped.

unverified_claims: Public segmenter provides a pericardium or equivalent class on CT-RATE-like scans
Dissociated joint support in CT-RATE
Commandeur EAT citation identifier
Novelty of decoding fat in a cardiomegaly classifier
candidates.plain_pitch: A widely used chest-CT AI produces a score for an enlarged heart. But the heart sits inside a layer of fat, and on scans the fat enlarges the overall silhouette while being clearly distinguishable from heart muscle by its darkness. We ask whether the AI counts that fat as heart: first by checking whether, among patients whose actual heart chambers are the same size, more fat means a higher enlarged-heart score; then by digitally recoloring the fat to look like muscle - without moving any boundary - and watching the score. If the score responds, 'enlarged heart' from this AI partly means 'fatty heart covering,' which is a different medical statement with different consequences.

candidates.title: The skeleton's tree rings: Harris lines inside the bone-age model
candidates.question: Is a bone-age model using Harris growth-arrest lines when it reads a child's hand radiograph?
candidates.deliverable_sentence: The bone-age model is using Harris growth-arrest lines.
candidates.rung: Mode C target is rung 1 via line-suppression counterfactuals; rung 2 requires showing the response is not a generic metaphyseal-density response (matched-energy shams); rung 3 is nearly free because Harris lines are a named radiologic entity - the consequence would be that 'bone age' partly encodes illness history, not just maturation.
candidates.rung_reached: Rung 1 at best this cycle; the illness-history interpretation would need cohorts with documented growth-arrest episodes, out of scope.
candidates.X_measurement: Within the distal radial and ulnar metaphysis (localizable with the keypoint/ROI steps already standard in public bone-age pipelines), extract the intensity profile along the shaft axis and count transverse sclerotic bands as peaks exceeding a prominence threshold over the smoothed profile, recording count, position, and contrast - a fully specified formula in the charter's 'well-defined measurement' sense; automated Harris-line detection has thin but existing literature (to be pinned; recalled, unverified). Compute-today test: YES - the rule is deterministic on any hand radiograph without an annotator, though its validity against the classical radiologic definition is the thing the novelty audit and Stage 0 must pressure-test.
candidates.suspected_signal: Severe illness, malnutrition, or chemotherapy transiently halts endochondral growth; on resumption a dense transverse line is left in the metaphysis - the skeleton records the event like a tree records a drought year. Lines are common in pediatric radiographs, high-contrast, and sit exactly in the metaphyseal region every bone-age reader and model attends to. A model trained to match radiologist-assigned bone age could use lines directly (readers may nudge assessments on atypical metaphyses) or as a correlated marker of the growth trajectory itself.
candidates.use_vs_association: Association (children with lines get different predictions) is confounded by everything about being ill; the design is paired: suppress the detected lines by replacing each band with texture interpolated from adjacent normal metaphysis, add matched-energy shams elsewhere in the bone, and read the frozen model's bone-age change - only within-image line removal isolates use.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: A frozen public bone-age model with competitive reported accuracy can be run locally on public hand radiographs and produces a continuous age estimate that is stable under sham edits - without a released checkpoint there is no behavior to decode.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The easy check is that the RSNA pediatric bone-age dataset and winning-solution repositories exist; still assumed and load-bearing: weights (not just training code) are released and runnable, and the line-suppression edit does not simultaneously alter the metaphyseal density gradient that legitimate maturation reading uses - if line removal and maturation cues are entangled at the metaphysis, a score change is ambiguous and the sham design must be extended to matched density-gradient controls. Also assumed: RSNA bone-age labels being radiologist-assigned does not matter here, because labels never enter the paired readout - the anchor model is simply a frozen artifact.
candidates.dies_like_prior: Annotation provenance - the program's dominant killer - is deliberately structurally avoided: the primary readout is a frozen model's paired response, and no label is interpreted. The live prior modes are DATA_ACCESS (idea-018) if no checkpoint is truly public, and edit-validity (idea-006 family) if band inpainting is detectable or entangled; both are named Stage-0 gates. No prior candidate covers this model class or X (closest, scout-011-c01, decodes a hand-radiograph SEX classifier via bone phenotypes - different model, different target, different X).
candidates.closest_prior_work: RSNA Pediatric Bone Age Challenge (Halabi et al., Radiology 2019 - identifier to be pinned) established public data and high-accuracy public solutions; bone-age interpretability work highlights carpals and metaphyses via saliency but, to current knowledge, no study has intervened on a named incidental finding like growth-arrest lines. candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: Stage 0: verify one checkpoint runs and reproduces reported holdout error within tolerance; run the line detector on 500 radiographs to establish prevalence and detector face-validity against the classical definition. Decisive step: on 60 line-positive cases, paired line-suppression versus matched-energy shams under a blinded discriminator; endpoint is the paired bone-age shift distribution, with line count as a graded dose variable.
candidates.standing_confounds_addressed: Within-image pairing fixes scanner, protocol, site, positioning, habitus, prevalence, referral, and labels. NOT ruled out by design: entanglement of lines with genuine maturation appearance at the same anatomic site - the extended sham/density-control arm addresses it partially and the residual is stated; detector validity (are these bands Harris lines or nutrient-vessel/beam artifacts) is a named Stage-0 question.
alternative_explanations: The model responds to any metaphyseal density perturbation, not lines specifically; matched-energy and gradient-preserving shams address this.

Detected bands are not Harris lines (vascular grooves, physeal remnants); Stage-0 face-validity and position/contrast criteria narrow but cannot fully resolve without a clinical gold standard, capping the naming claim.
Edit seams drive the response; the discriminator gate addresses it.
candidates.anticipated_negative: Decisive at the model level with a validated editor: bone-age models ignore growth-arrest lines, itself a publishable check on the folklore that models read 'everything'; uninterpretable only if the edit gates fail.

candidates.plain_pitch: When a child is seriously ill or malnourished, their bones briefly stop growing, and each pause leaves a thin white line near the ends of the bones - the skeleton keeps rings like a tree. AI systems that estimate a child's developmental 'bone age' from a hand X-ray study exactly the regions where these lines sit. We ask whether the AI is reading the lines: we detect them automatically, digitally smooth them away, and check whether the estimated age shifts. If it does, bone-age AI is partly reading a child's illness history rather than their growth stage - which would matter for the sick children in whom the estimate is used most.

candidates.title: The cage remembers the hyperinflation: barrel chest inside the emphysema score
candidates.question: Is CT-CLIP's emphysema score using barrel-chest thoracic-cage geometry - the skeleton's record of chronic hyperinflation?
candidates.deliverable_sentence: The emphysema score is using barrel-chest thoracic-cage geometry.
candidates.rung: Mode C target is rung 1 via representation-level erasure with separability gates; rung 2 requires the cage direction to be shown distinct from the parenchymal low-attenuation direction; rung 3 is nearly free - barrel chest is a physician's term - and the finding would mean the model reads the skeleton's chronic record on top of the parenchyma's current state.
candidates.rung_reached: Rung 1 at best, and only conditional on the separability gate; a failed gate lands honestly at 'cage geometry is not separably encoded,' which is idea-009's fate and is planned for.
candidates.X_measurement: Three formulaic indices from public whole-body segmentation masks (rib cage, sternum, vertebrae): anteroposterior-to-transverse inner-thoracic diameter ratio at fixed vertebral levels; sternovertebral distance normalized to body size; mean rib inclination angle from per-rib principal axes. All computable today on any chest CT by established segmentation plus geometry, no annotator. The comparator/nuisance measure is the standard emphysema index (percentage of lung voxels below -950 HU, LAA-950), also formulaic. Compute-today test: YES.
candidates.suspected_signal: Chronic hyperinflation remodels the thorax over years: the diaphragm flattens, ribs horizontalize, the anteroposterior diameter grows - the classical barrel chest. The cage is therefore a slow integrator of disease history, partly independent of today's parenchymal attenuation (which varies with inspiration and acquisition). A model trained on report labels could exploit the cage as a stable disease record, and no saliency study would distinguish that from parenchymal reading.
candidates.use_vs_association: Cage geometry correlates with emphysema by construction, so association is worthless; the design decodes cage indices from the frozen model's internal representation, verifies decodability CONDITIONAL on LAA-950 and lung volume (the idea-009 gate), then erases the cage-geometry subspace and compares the emphysema-score drop against equal-rank random erasures and an LAA-950-direction erasure - selective degradation is the use signature.
candidates.keystone_prerequisite: Cage-geometry indices are decodable from the frozen checkpoint's features conditional on LAA-950 and lung volume on joint support - i.e., the cage is separably encoded, not merely a shadow of parenchymal emphysema; if false, the study is uninterpretable and must stop at the gate.
candidates.keystone_residual_assumption: The nearest checkable facts - the pipeline exposes usable intermediate features, segmentation runs on the cohort - are adjacent. The load-bearing assumption is the conditional-separability keystone itself, which cannot be inspected without running the probe; this card therefore treats the gate as the first deliverable and claims nothing beyond it. Second load-bearing assumption: CT-CLIP behaves in-distribution on LIDC-IDRI images (chosen to respect the CT-RATE dataset cap), which differ in era and protocol from CT-RATE - checked by score-distribution sanity gates before any science.
candidates.dies_like_prior: This is knowingly idea-009's shape (geometry inseparable from correlated disease killed it, IDENTIFIABILITY_FAILURE) and scout-015-c02's grammar (erasure with nuisance controls). The difference is procedural, not rhetorical: the separability gate is promoted to the keystone and the first stage, so the idea-009 failure mode terminates the study at Stage 0 with a cheap, informative negative instead of contaminating a use claim. Annotation provenance does not apply: labels are unused; LIDC's cursed annotations are irrelevant because only its images enter.
candidates.closest_prior_work: In-portfolio: scout-014-c03 (Haller index into the cardiomegaly head) shares the skeleton-into-soft-tissue-head move but targets a congenital deformity as a potential confound; here the cage change is CAUSED by the disease and is proposed as a legitimate record the model reads - the causal direction and head differ. scout-015-c02 shares the erasure grammar on a different model and X. External: barrel-chest quantification on CT exists in the COPD morphometry literature (unpinned); no known work decodes cage geometry from a chest-CT classifier's representation. All unverified pending audit.
candidates.existing_assets: Frozen CT-CLIP stack in-repo (feature access to be added, not retrained); LIDC-IDRI images public on TCIA without DUA; public segmentation tooling; all X and nuisance measures are formulaic.
candidates.smallest_decisive_experiment: Stage 0 (the gate, and the whole first claim): on 200 LIDC volumes, compute cage indices, LAA-950, and lung volume; verify CT-CLIP score distributions are sane on this cohort; cross-fit probes for cage indices from frozen features, raw and conditional on LAA-950 plus lung volume. Only if conditional decoding clears a preregistered margin: erase the cage subspace and compare emphysema-score degradation against equal-rank random and LAA-direction erasures on held-out cases.
candidates.standing_confounds_addressed: Reconstruction kernel and scanner vary within LIDC and enter the probe as covariates (kernel-stratified decoding); positioning and inspiration affect both cage measurement (less) and parenchyma (more), favoring the cage-as-stable-record hypothesis but demanding inspiration-proxy covariates (tracheal cross-section); habitus enters cage normalization explicitly; site, prevalence, referral, and labels do not touch the representation-level readout. Sex is a named covariate - cage shape is sexually dimorphic - and is decodable from chest CT, so the conditional probe must include it.
alternative_explanations: The 'cage direction' is a body-habitus or sex direction in disguise; conditional probes including habitus and sex covariates address this.
Erasure damages a general geometry manifold, not cage reading; equal-rank random and nuisance-direction erasures address generic damage.
Domain shift on LIDC makes features degenerate; the score-sanity gate addresses it, at the cost of external validity to CT-RATE-like data.
candidates.anticipated_negative: The gate negative (cage not separably encoded) is decisive and cheap - it says the skeleton's record is not independently available to this model, closing the question for this checkpoint. The erasure negative after a passed gate is decisive against use. Both are type 1.

cross_domain.borrowed_construct: Structural mechanics - a pressure vessel's permanent deformation as a load-history integrator
cross_domain.implied_measurement: Cage geometry as a time-integrated record versus parenchymal attenuation as an instantaneous state; the design's conditional-decoding contrast (stable record vs current state) follows from it
cross_domain.what_changes_if_dropped: Without the record-versus-state framing, there is no reason to test cage geometry CONDITIONAL on current parenchymal attenuation - the analogy dictates the conditioning structure of the probe, so it is load-bearing for the design, not decoration.

candidates.remaining_legwork: One week for segmentation, indices, and score-sanity on LIDC; one week for probe training and the gate decision - the gate itself is the first publishable checkpoint. Mode C: feasibility reported, not scored into priority.
candidates.entry_point_2_requirements: Measurement: the three cage indices above. Confusable artifact: sex and habitus geometry, plus kernel-dependent feature shifts on the transfer cohort; all named as probe covariates.

candidates.plain_pitch: Years of severe emphysema slowly reshape the chest itself: the rib cage rounds out into the classic 'barrel chest' a physician can spot on sight. A chest-CT AI that scores emphysema is supposed to be reading the damaged lung tissue, but the reshaped skeleton is sitting in the same picture, recording the disease's whole history. We ask whether the AI has learned to read the cage as well as the lung. The test first checks whether the AI's internal representation carries rib-cage shape as separate information from lung damage - and if that gate fails, we stop and say so - then removes just that information and watches whether the emphysema score weakens. A yes would mean the AI reads the skeleton's memory of the disease, not only its current state.
